_source: SIMULATED - this describes a scheduled background run that does not exist yet
_why: In a finished product a scheduled job would read the data every morning, work out what changed and send the manager a digest. We have not built that job. This file describes what such a run would have done, so the screen can show it. The savings figures are assumptions, not measurements, which is why each one is shown with the basis behind it.

steps.title: Run started
steps.detail: Scheduled weekday run for Rajeev Menon, covering all three plants.

steps.title: Read the current position
steps.detail: Five documents waiting for approval, six materials checked against their reorder point, four suppliers with ten orders of history each.

steps.title: Checked against the limits
steps.detail: Three documents past 24 hours, two materials with cover shorter than the lead time, one rate more than 5 percent above contract.

steps.title: Worked out the causes
steps.detail: Missing stand-in for one approver, no cost centre owner for another approval, a consumption spike on gypsum. Six situations raised.

steps.title: Scored the suppliers
steps.detail: Aditya Refractories dropped to 55 out of 100 and was flagged before order 4500178401 is approved.

steps.title: Chose the three priorities
steps.detail: Ranked by value at risk and time waiting, with the supplier trend attached to the approval.

steps.title: Delivered the digest
steps.detail: Email to the head of procurement, and the dashboard updated.
